journey.title: From a house sound to a delivered track
journey.purpose: The scenario's primary path, and the one the take-set contract exists to serve: configure a style once, generate a batch of takes from it, audition them against each other, reserve one, and leave the rest in the pool so asking for a different track costs nothing.

steps.intent: Capture a house sound once as data and see the caption and parameters it compiles to.
Submit a batch of takes from that style, knowing the cost and the rung before the work starts.
Compare the takes against each other as peers and decide which one to keep.
Reserve the chosen take so no other consumer is offered the same track.
See that consuming the take dropped the pool below its threshold and that replenishment is already running.
